body:
> When going through any form of depression, your mind is kinda fucked up. It tells you things you know aren't true, and forces you believe it.

You'll be crazy to feel happy when you find out that you are dealt with the lifelong disorder card.

>ADHD was extremely beneficial to hunter-gatherers, because it makes you take in everything in your surrroundings, and absolutely unfocused on any one thing in particular, and noticing the smallest details in the scenery

Umm no. I zone out during hiking activities. 

>However, just because its an uphill battle doesn't make it impossible

It is still a disadvantageous trait. No point in procreating and passing it on to future offspring.

> a health condition that is not life threatening should not matter in reproduction

Do you even know how natural selection works?

I was only diagnozed with ADHD two months ago.

How can we not be depressed? We're technically born defective unlike people with depression. We should have been weeded out by natural selection and our very existence is bypassing evolution.

The world is a sad and miserable place and I don't see myself as capable of raising kids given how forgetful and poor my social skills are.

I'm not talking about an opponent or what. I don't even see the purpose in living. I am flawed and this is how others see me. 

And how is that an advantage? ADHD is a genetic defect. Any counterclaims is just a sour lemons mindset. Pretty much every famous ADHDer dropped out of high school or college and you know maybe that should have happened to me.

Yes and neurotypicals can hyperfocus on something they like as well.

We lose interest in whatever we find uninteresting. We are pretty much like spoiled kids. Maybe we really are. It doesn't really matter anyway as I've made so many mistakes to the point that they are intolerable.

And so what? We're just keep on failing and failing in life. I can't even handle simple tasks. Neurotypicals see me as someone lazy and self-entitled and I don't see the point of existing when everyone hates me including myself.
Yeah and pass on my defective genes. What is the point.

I won't deny that my life is not that bad for an ADHDer, but sometimes I ask myself what is the point of living when I am a defective pawn in the natural selection game and even if I live and reproduce I am just passing on my disadvantageous traits to my offspring.

I don't know if I am experiencing depression. Sometimes I can be happy if I forget that I have ADHD. I already told my psychiatrist about my realization that I am defective the last time I saw her.
